messages:
Maya (support): FYI customer reported 400s on function-call after we rolled the model to redwood-v4-canary at 09:12 UTC. They say the tool selection payload is missing required fields.
Liam (eng-runtime): Can you paste the API error and the body that failed validation?
Maya (support): Here's the response they get when invoking /v1/execute: 
```
{"error": "tool_invocation_failed", "details": "schema validation failed: missing required field 'tool_args.metadata'"}
```
And the original call (redacted keys) looked like: 
```
{"model":"redwood-v4-canary","input":"generate invoice","tools":[],"tool_call":"auto"}
```
Maya (support): Customer says same request worked on redwood-v3-stable two hours earlier.
Deploy Bot: rollout(redwood-v4-canary) -> 09:12 UTC; canary traffic=10%; region=us-west.
Jamie (ml): Quick hypothesis: v4-canary is returning tool_choice with slightly different arg nesting for one of our tool adapters. If the model suggests a tool name that maps to a new schema, runtime validation can reject it.
Liam (eng-runtime): Please attach a raw model output example — we need the 'tool' object the model returned.
Maya (support): Customer pasted this model reply (sanitized): 
```
{"type":"tool_call","name":"invoice.create","arguments":{"payload":{"amount":125.0}}}
```
Maya (support): Notice it's nested under arguments.payload, but our invoice.create adapter expects arguments.amount at top-level. That's why validation fails.
Ronja (platform): Can we map or coerce that automatically in runtime as a temporary fallback? Might be risky.
Liam (eng-runtime): We could add a permissive layer to accept either shape for that tool but only behind a feature flag. Need quick patch and test.
Sree (oncall): Customer impact? How many requests? Are 400s spiking?
Maya (support): Customer reports ~30% of their invocations failing since 09:15. They are in production flow.
Deploy Bot: metrics(canary) -> tool_call_400_rate: 0.28 (canary), 0.01 (stable). latency_p50 unchanged.
Alex (cs): This customer is on committed capacity. We need an ETA for rollback or mitigation. They're asking for an immediate hotfix or rollback.
Jamie (ml): Root cause is model-side change in suggested argument wrapping. We can either: 1) patch runtime to accept both shapes for invoice.create, or 2) rollback canary to redwood-v3-stable for that customer or region.
Liam (eng-runtime): Short-term: revert canary routing for affected tenant(s) — safer. I'll open a rollback and limit to the tenant. Medium-term: add tolerant schema adapter.
Ronja (platform): I can trigger a targeted rollback for that customer and hold off full-scale rollback. Need tenant id and region.
Maya (support): Tenant id provided in private thread. Please proceed.
Sree (oncall): Also capturing logs: request_id=rcp-9a3f, model_response_snippet saved to incident storage.
Liam (eng-runtime): Action items: 1) Ronja rollback tenant routing (in progress), 2) Liam & Jamie to spec tolerant adapter PR (ETA 4h), 3) Sree to monitor 400 rate until rollback complete.
Ronja (platform): Rolling back canary routing for tenant now -> reverted at 09:32 UTC.
Deploy Bot: rollback(redwood-v4-canary) -> success for tenant id xxxxx at 09:32 UTC.
Maya (support): Customer confirmation: "traffic back to normal, thanks" :relieved: (confirmed at 09:35).
Alex (cs): Thanks team — request customer postmortem template and offer a short SLA credit if they want.
Jamie (ml): We'll add a model onboarding checklist to validate tool arg shapes before rollout.
Liam (eng-runtime): Will create the permissive adapter PR and run unit tests against both shapes. Link after CI.
Maya (support): Closing for now; will reopen if customer sees recurrence. Thanks all.
